g.text: Morning! The new palette derivation just landed.
want to sanity-check the new palette?
Seeds → derived tokens. Edit the vars up top and every surface shifts:
// --muted-foreground is fed by the comment color
Dark pair auto-switches with the OS — try tweaking --primary up top ✨
the unread divider is --destructive, badges ride --primary.

svg.text: Open in a browser · edit the custom properties in the <style> block · values are copy-paste compatible with desktop/src/shared/styles/globals/theme.css

Runtime note: --primary / --sidebar-primary / --sidebar-active (+foregrounds) are overwritten by the accent picker (default #3b82f6; Buzz themes pin the neutral fg/bg swap) · --status-* and --ui-warning* come from adaptive-theme.ts fallbacks, not theme.css · --chart-* only exist as static values and are never re-derived per theme.
